title: Dangerous Escalation: US–Israel Strikes on Iran and Iran’s Retaliation Raise Fears of Wider War
excerpt: A sharp escalation between the United States, Israel, and Iran has triggered global alarm, raising fears of a wider regional conflict and the possibility of a catastrophic world war.
author: Sardar Nasir Aziz Khan

heroImage.caption: Rising regional tensions following US–Israel strikes and Iran’s retaliation

body.text: Sardar Nasir Aziz Khan, Central Spokesperson of the United Kashmir People’s National Party, has issued a strong warning regarding the rapidly escalating military confrontation between the United States, Israel, and Iran.

On 28 February 2026, coordinated strikes by the United States and Israel against Iranian targets sharply intensified tensions across the Middle East. Tehran responded with missile and drone attacks on Israel and U.S. military positions in the region, triggering fears of a broader and more destructive conflict.
When nations exchange airstrikes and missile attacks, the risk of a wider regional war — even a global war — increases dramatically.

Sardar Nasir Aziz Khan emphasized that such escalations can draw in additional regional and global powers, creating conditions that could spiral into a devastating world war. He warned that the consequences of a full‑scale conflict would be catastrophic for civilians across the region and beyond.

body.caption: Escalating tensions threaten regional stability and global security

body.text: War brings destruction on a massive scale. Hundreds of thousands could lose their lives, and millions may be displaced. Global trade, energy markets, and essential services would face severe disruption, affecting not only the Middle East but the entire world.

Civilians — especially women, children, and the elderly — suffer first and suffer most. Rising food and fuel prices, destroyed infrastructure, and long‑term psychological trauma become the lasting legacy of war.

The world has repeatedly witnessed how localized violence can quickly spill across borders. In such circumstances, it is vital for world leaders to prioritize dialogue and negotiation instead of further military action.

Sardar Nasir Aziz Khan urged all concerned countries to step back from confrontation and act with responsibility. He stressed that peace must be given a chance and that diplomacy is the only path that can prevent further chaos and destruction.
We must give peace a chance. Countries must choose diplomacy over war.
